triggers.description: Evidence from authoritative sources or repository behaviour conflicts.
Material requirements remain ambiguous after bounded investigation.
More than two plausible implementation paths remain.
Security-sensitive behaviour or a trust boundary is encountered.
A public API, schema, protocol, or compatibility contract may change.
Production systems, infrastructure, or persistent data are involved.
A bounded diagnosis has failed after two attempts.
Configured subsystem or file-scope thresholds are crossed.
Verification results are inconsistent or cannot be reproduced.
The current agent cannot establish a reliable answer with its capability or context.
